title: Vortex Sour Apple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Sour Apple captures the crisp and refreshing taste of Green Apple, enhanced with a sharp sour twist for an added burst of flavour. This simple yet vibrant profile offers a bright and tangy vape, perfect for fans of sour-inspired blends. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Sour Apple delivers smooth vapour and bold flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits and starter systems. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, offering a satisfying and flavourful experience. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are available in a convenient 10ml format, providing a more sustainable and economical alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Sour Apple is a refreshing option for fruit lovers. Pair this e-liquid with your refillable vapes or vape starter kits for effortless vaping.
